items.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: I can't remember any of them that I knew. Who cared for it? Except Myra Lopum, who was a little, I was slightly shocked when she took it up so seriously.

ctx.x: Do you remember when people, did any of your contemporaries, your friends in New Orleans, like it?

I can't remember any of them that I knew. Who cared for it? Except Myra Lopum, who was a little, I was slightly shocked when she took it up so seriously. Who was that? Who was that? Myra Lopum is remember.
Oh, that was years ago. That's the last one I wanted. I mean, that's years after a lifetime. She was younger than I am.
